summary: Calumet, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on September 11, 2026 it entered the Eleventh Amendment to its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, increasing revolving commitments from $500.0 million to $600.0 million, subject to borrowing base limitations, with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent. Concurrently, the company executed the Fourth Amendment to its Monetization Master Agreement with J. Aron Company LLC and affiliates, permitting the commitment increase. The filing is a routine credit-facility and financing-arrangement disclosure under Items 1.01 and 2.03. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were stated; no special-situation event is present.
